remarks:
Welcome Home! This well-loved 4-bedroom home offers over ¾ of an acre in a private, peaceful setting with a large, flat rear yard and plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors. Located in Orchard Park, West Seneca school district, this property offers space, privacy, and endless possibilities to make it your own.

The spacious eat-in kitchen features ample room and includes all appliances. A large living space with tons of natural light makes a great space for hosting, a well appointed four-piece bathroom and two generously sized bedrooms are conveniently located on the first floor, each offering good closet space. Upstairs, you’ll find two additional bedrooms—or the flexibility to create a bedroom plus a wardrobe/dressing room, home office, hobby space, or whatever best suits your needs.

Features include Pella windows downstairs and vinyl replacement windows upstairs, with shades on all windows, ceiling fans, and brand-new carpeting in all bedrooms.

Step outside onto the back deck overlooking the tranquil backyard. With so much space, there are endless possibilities for entertaining, gardening, recreation, or simply enjoying your own private retreat. A spacious 16' x 12' shed provides excellent additional storage.

The full, dry basement, offers plenty of potential for storage and workspace, along with good-working mechanicals and a newer furnace.

This is a home that has been well loved and cared for, and it's now ready for its next owner. Bring your personal touches and make the cosmetic updates that will transform this house into your own home. Offers will be reviewed as they come in, but seller reserves the right to set a deadline for offers at a later time.
